entries.title: Evaluate Interest Form submissions before they belong to an event
entries.summary: each Interest Form now carries an evaluation plan with rounds, scorecards, blind review, assignment logic, summary, exports and reminders, scored on the form's own fields. Evaluators added by email join with the new read-only **Evaluator** role and review in your organization-level Site's portal under My Reviews; a new **Evaluations** tab on **CRM → Interest Forms** lists every plan across forms.

entries.title: Slides: branded holding slides from your own PowerPoint template
entries.summary: upload a .pptx with `{{session.title}}`, `{{speaker.1.name}}` and other tokens (or start from your Brand kit), preview it against a real session, then generate one slide per session or per presenter as a combined deck or one file per session, attached to each session as a **Holding Slide** file. Available on every event under Marketing → Slides and from the sessions list via Create → Slides; Media and Create are now on for every event too.

entries.title: Evaluate subsessions on their own
entries.summary: a new plan first asks whether it evaluates parent submissions or subsessions. Subsession plans list only subsessions in assignments and public voting, can show the parent session for context, and add a Parent session column to exports.

entries.title: Community polling: random ballots, eligible-voter lists and weighted results
entries.summary: public voting rounds can deal each voter a fixed random subset of sessions, restrict voting to an uploaded list of ticket holders and community members, and report weighted averages (ticket holders ×2) with distinct-voter counts in the results table and exports.

entries.title: Content Galleries: Session Catalog, Learning Catalog and Webinar Library templates
entries.summary: the Session Catalog now renders as catalog rows with session codes, abstracts, speakers and a filter rail for day, track, session type, level, topic, speaker, room, language, credits and *Recording available*, sorted in program order. The new Learning Catalog brings lessons and webinar recordings together with credit type, credit amount, format, price and series filters; the new Webinar Library publishes recordings from a connected webinar platform automatically as they land. Filters can now be built from your own Sessions dropdown fields.

entries.title: Which one do I need?
entries.summary: every CMS list page compares Site, Embeds, Poster Gallery and Content Gallery, and creates the right template in one click.

entries.title: Apply reviewer recommendations in bulk
entries.summary: map Accept, Decline, and Alternate to submission statuses, set acceptance targets per session type, then preview and apply the reviewers' majority recommendations from the Submissions tab.

entries.title: Session builds with alternates and pre-created sessions
entries.summary: team leads fill Presenters and Alternates zones, can fill program sessions you set aside for them, and see acceptance progress. The Builds tab groups builds by team lead, lets you edit a build before approving, return it for changes, or finalize a team lead's sessions at once. Approving turns each presenter abstract into its own subsession.

entries.title: Prior-round context for reviewers
entries.summary: later-round cards show the prior-round average and recommendations, and reviewers can sort by prior-round average and filter by recommendation.

entries.title: Choose which participants appear on a parent session
entries.summary: a new **Subsessions** agenda setting shows all subsession participants, the presenting author only, or none on the parent session.

entries.title: Sequence subsession times
entries.summary: schedule a session's subsessions back to back with a default duration, a gap, and per-type durations, previewed before you apply.

entries.title: The admin app in German, Spanish, and French, end to end
entries.summary: roughly 1,800 labels, buttons, messages, and empty states that still showed in English now follow your language, and relative dates such as "3 days ago" read in it too. Choose your language from your profile icon in the top right, under **Language**; it is saved to your account, so it follows you to any browser.
